# Förvaltaren "Det här skulle kunna vara den viktigaste traden"

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon features guest Lars-Erik Lundgren of Aktieansvar. The main macro theme is the Japanese yen: a rate hike from the Bank of Japan and an unwinding of the yen carry trade are framed as possibly the most important macro story, and Asian asset specialist Katherine Young adds her view on it. On the stock side, the guest is positive on Electrolux Professional (a new holding), Hexagon's spin-off Octave and SSAB, which could benefit from Canadian steel tariffs. He is trimming Nordea and moving banks toward neutral, underweights H&M after its rally, and sees SKF as fully valued ahead of its split.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EPRO-B — Electrolux Professional | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

New fund holding. De-rated on P/E and EV/EBIT over 1.5 years, heavy capex program ending, stable laundry business.

#### Reasoning

The guest (Lundgren, Aktieansvar) bought a new position because of the valuation gap to peers and to H&M. Capex of 300-350m a year, against about 200m before, falls off this year and next. Small-cap restructuring pressure (AP funds, PPM) is easing. The laundry side is stable; the upside is in US restaurants. He dismisses GLP-1 weight-loss drugs as a threat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US restaurant demand fails to pick up
- if the capex decline does not happen
- if consumers cut back on eating out

> *"Det är den här värderingsskillnaden som har blivit mot andra bolag. Den har ju de-ratat på PN-nivå, ev-ebit"*

---

### 🟢 SSAB-B — SSAB | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Canada's steel tariffs of up to 50% seen as positive for SSAB, at least short term.

#### Reasoning

The guest says that, all else equal, the tariff escalation between Canada and the US benefits SSAB. SSAB fell 7% the last time the two sides neared a deal, so renewed conflict should help the share price. He explicitly calls this short-term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Canada and the US reach a trade deal
- if the tariffs are removed

> *"allt annat lika så tror jag att det är positivt för SSAB"*

---

### 🔴 HM-B — H&M | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Fund cut to underweight: the stock rallied near 180 without a consumer recovery, is relatively expensive, and faces index outflows on 1 Dec.

#### Reasoning

The guest reduced his overweight because the price rose even though consumer demand did not recover. H&M has become expensive relative to other consumer stocks. The SIX free-float index adjustment on 1 Dec should lower H&M's weight and cause outflows. The Shein IPO could also pull money away, though he sees a Shein listing as positive for H&M overall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consumer demand clearly recovers
- if the report is strong

> *"Trots det har kursen gått, så det kanske är dags att dra ner den lite."*

---

### 🔴 NDA-SE — Nordea | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fund trimmed Nordea, moving banks toward neutral after a strong run and higher valuations.

#### Reasoning

Banks have performed very well and are now valued higher. With cautious optimism on the economy, the guest expects banks not to lead in a recovery, though they would hold up better in a downturn. Nordea was the bank chosen for trimming. This is portfolio rebalancing, not a negative view on Nordea itself.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the economy weakens and banks outperform

> *"Vi har sålt av lite Nordea... Vi har rört oss mot att vara neutrala."*

---

### 🟡 SKF-B — SKF | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

The guest thinks SKF is highly valued with much of the potential taken; he will reassess after the 1 Dec split, when weak early trading could create an opportunity.

#### Reasoning

The split has been priced in to a large extent. The industrial part has better margins, but the multiples after the split are unknown. Stocks often come under unreasonable pressure in the first weeks after a spin-off, so an entry chance may appear later.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the split parts get weak multiples

> *"Spontant tycker jag att SKF är ganska högt värderat just nu."*

---

### 🟡 GETI-B — Getinge | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Held in the fund; the best medtech recovery thanks to fixing quality problems, new products and a life-science pickup.

#### Reasoning

Getinge is the guest's medtech holding. Its quality problems are being dealt with, new products are coming, and the life-science side is picking up across bigger companies. The broader Swedish medtech sector is down more than 50% from its peak and heavily shorted, which a cited guest (Björn Olander) sees as increasingly interesting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if quality problems return

> *"Vi har ju Getinge... Det är väl de som har återhämtat sig bäst."*

---

### 🟠 VITR — Vitrolife | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named as a possible candidate among beaten-down medtech stocks.

#### Reasoning

The guest mentioned Vitrolife only briefly when asked about beaten-down, heavily shorted medtech names.

> *"Vitrolife skulle kunna vara ett sånt."*

---

### 🟠 RAY-B — RaySearch | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Possible medtech candidate, but perhaps still highly valued.

#### Reasoning

The guest named RaySearch as a medtech idea but flagged that it may still be highly valued.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the valuation stays high

> *"Raysearch skulle kunna vara ett sånt. Kanske lite högt värderat fortfarande."*
